limitations: Controlled PoW-disabled isolated regtest, not standard/public testnet.
All DKG shares are on one host; no independent operator transport/security claim.
The source bank uses an ordinary owned spending key and local dealer split; the later DKG spend reads no master spending key.
Scanner trusts the full-node RPC and its birthday; it does not independently verify consensus or SPV.
Four funded bids, authenticated admission, latest six receipt memos, bindings and settlement remain to be connected in ONE NU7 run.
This transfer gate is not durable auction custody/recovery and performs no MPC/row binding.
